dialogues.title: Meeting at the Café
dialogues.description: Two people introduce themselves at a café.

lines.text: שלום! קוראים לי דנה. איך קוראים לך?
lines.translation: Shalom! Qor'im li Dana. Eikh qor'im lekha? — Hello! My name is Dana. What's your name?
Qor'im li Omer. Na'im me'od! — My name is Omer. Nice to meet you!
Me'eifo ata? — Where are you from?
Ani miTel Aviv. Ve'at? — I'm from Tel Aviv. And you?
Nekhmad! At studentit? — Nice! Are you a student?

dialogues.title: Asking for Directions
dialogues.description: A tourist asks a local for directions to the train station.

lines.translation: Slikha, eikh magi'im letakhanat harakevet? — Excuse me, how do I get to the train station?
Yashar kadima, ve'az smola baramzor. — Straight ahead, then left at the traffic light.
Ze rakhoq mikan? — Is it far from here?
Lo, raq khamesh daqot halikha. — No, just a five-minute walk.
Toda raba al ha'ezra! — Thank you very much for the help!
Bevaqasha, nesi'a tova! — You're welcome, have a good trip!

dialogues.title: A Job Interview
dialogues.description: A candidate discusses experience and how he handles pressure.

lines.text: ספר לי קצת על הניסיון התעסוקתי שלך.
lines.translation: Saper li qtsat al hanisayon hata'asuqati shelkha. — Tell me a bit about your professional experience.

lines.text: עבדתי כמפתח תוכנה במשך שלוש שנים.
lines.translation: Avadeti kemefateakh tokhna bemeshekh shalosh shanim. — I worked as a software developer for three years.

lines.text: מה היה הפרויקט המאתגר ביותר שלך?
lines.translation: Ma haya haproyeqt hameatgger beyoter shelkha? — What was your most challenging project?

lines.text: פיתחתי מערכת שהתמודדה עם עומס גבוה מאוד.
lines.translation: Pitakhti maarekhet shehitmodeda im omes gavoha meod. — I developed a system that handled very high load.

lines.text: איך אתה מתמודד עם לחץ בעבודה?
lines.translation: Eikh ata mitmoded im lakhats ba'avoda? — How do you handle pressure at work?

lines.text: אני מנסה לתעדף משימות ולשמור על ראש קר.
lines.translation: Ani menase leta'adef mesimot velishmor al rosh qar. — I try to prioritize tasks and stay calm.
